name: tauri-sidecar-desktop
description: Architecture and pitfalls for desktop apps built as shell + web frontend + background sidecar (Tauri 2 + Node, also Electron + child process): pixel-accurate click-through for transparent windows, single-source contracts enforced by architecture tests, NDJSON IPC, atomic JSON storage, data migration, process-level and packaged sidecar tests, and a plugin host.
